feat(evals): re-score runs 1 and 2 by the scenario's end

## Intent

The new measure of the scenario's end is read from the transcripts only, so both earlier runs can be scored again without model calls. They need comparable numbers for "Code done", and their conclusions must rest on them.

## Key changes

- The transcript dimension is now scenario_end. Only the creator's last message after the plan's yes counts: the GitHub answer, the stop at publishing or the thanks to a done agent, worded freely. Only the persona's stuck line at the start of that message is the stuck end.
- Run 1 is re-scored from its transcripts: "Code done" is 100 % in every cell. Haiku's explainer runs that stayed at phase: code ended regularly with a green check. The current phase detection moves one Haiku run to "created before the plan" and lowers the turns after the plan in three runs.
- Run 2 is re-scored the same way: "Code done" is 3/3 in every cell except Haiku's interactive one (1/3). Creates before the plan drop to 3 runs, and skills in their phase rise to 76–95 % for Sonnet and Opus.
- The conclusions of both runs follow the new numbers.

moved.why: The final results of run 2's re-score complete this request; the idea in i162 led to the commit of i163, so i162 has no commits left.
